name: Nakane Akina
source:
The younger sister of the heroine, Miho.

Her appearance is the complete opposite of her older sister Miho’s; she has a boyish short haircut and is a cheerful girl who, every summer, ends up with a natural tan.

She has striking, well-defined features. Her mannerisms are cute rather than feminine.

She has a thing for muscular guys.
